reserveReview.rationale: The official dashboard API snapshot lastUpdated 2026-10-29T18:35:59Z, observed 2026-10-29, reports $3,570,830.8840391636 of cross-chain USDC, $1,948,034.2730456924 of cross-chain USDT, $10,596.306977011669 of Sonic USSD, $126.608848773253 of Ethereum USDe and $24,528.506110266855 of Ethereum crvUSD. The complete nine collateral rows across Ethereum, Sonic and BNB Smart Chain sum to $5,554,116.579020908, matching the summed per-chain tvlUsd; percentages use those unrounded token TVLs, not display-rounded sharePct or ftUSD supply. Weights moved against the October 10 review — USDC 68.28% to 64.29% and USDT 31.08% to 35.07% — because Sonic USDC collateral fell while USDT rose; the six reviewed collateral identities and the chain set are unchanged. USDG remains an explicitly observed zero row. FDUSD is again absent from this snapshot and stays removed rather than represented as an observed zero. No unreviewed positive collateral row exists, so measured unknown exposure is zero. These categories describe collateral wrapper claims, not debt-netted strategy assets, independent financial assurance, or guaranteed withdrawal liquidity.
